record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change each NextItNet block's residual addition from residual+y to residual+0.5*y. Retain both causal convolutions, GELU, normalization, dropout, dilation schedule and block count. A smaller residual contribution may stabilize the eight-block network and reduce amplification of noisy context while retaining its receptive field. Preserve features, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer; apply the identical block formula in prediction.

Preserve causal convolutions, embeddings, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer.
